entries.content:
Main City of mortals that is located underground. 
It has advanced technology(cyberpunk style) in the underground, illuminated by lanterns. 
When it's evening the cave walls above the city shine like stars to simulate the night outside of the undergrounds. In the day a big artificial sun is turned on to keep the cave warm and illuminated. The city is protected from demons by the guardian angels Cooperation and the military force cooperation.

Creatures that attack humans since Satan opened up hell gates all around the surface of earth. All Demons are human devouring creatures that kill humans in the most horrific way. Demons have mostly inhuman features and huge wings. Sometimes they appear as beasts like big wolves with sharp teeth and horns on their head. Most demons are brainless and their only purpose is to kill humans.

Classes of demons: 
S class demon: strongest demon type, mostly humanoid forms of demons.
A class demon: strong demons in beast forms, that are actually smart, strategic and can talk.
B class demons: beast form demons that are brainless and only there to war humans.

Luzifer, also known as Satan is the lord of the hell and the king of demons. He has declared war against the humans and angels. He is a fallen angel with huge black wings and two black horns. He possesses inhuman speed and the ability to control other demons. He can also control flames and burn his enemies. He is seen as the strongest among demons.

An organization of Angels that is located in the middle of Sandrone. It's a big building with many angels working there to protect humans and earth.

The rank of Angels are split in three Ranks. 
S = strongest type of guardian angels, the person they guard gets a "guardian ring" that can amplify their angel's strength. 
A = Strong guardian angels without a guardian ring. 
B = Low class guardians that are usually present for people that are not walking outside much and don't need high protection.

A ring that is only given to S class Angel Guardian owners. They can activate the ring by casting a spell, or using their mana. It amplifies the powers of the guardian angel by ten times, making them very strong. Nevertheless using the guardian ring can sometimes lead to the owner fainting, when it's activated for to long. It also is a risk to use it and can even kill the owner when used to long.
